cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Act as If It’s True
cards.instruction: Ask for one concrete choice that would only make sense if the impossible premise were true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put two place cards together like you. Both versions of your sister. She's bringing her future self; reserve two chairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I stacked ours to carry them. I only saved her one chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cards ready, yes. Use mine. I won't make either of her eat standing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put the extra chair beside hers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write 'tomorrow' on its place card. I need to know which one can tell me how tonight went.

reason: Copied card stack mistaken for temporal guest pairing; seat shortage and adjacent arrangement cause A sacrifice and date label contingent on future-self premise.
